name: HERO / clips, still study + synthetic control

scenes.label: Shot 1 visible environment / environment / revision 1
assumptions: Independent per-shot snapshot; no cross-shot geometry fusion.
Camera intrinsics are a prior. Relative depth and hidden surfaces are unmeasured.
Foreground drawings and effects may remain in the visible surface; semantic background separation is not established.
Single-view surface only: occluded regions and unseen geometry remain unresolved.
Z=1/((1-d)/near+d/far) is an inverse-affine visualization prior; it does not recover original model disparity or metric scale.
Input depth is already normalized with higher values farther; valid values are not renormalized here.
Camera pose and focal length are supplied priors; reprojection consistency is not independent calibration evidence.
A bounded pixel grid is sampled without filling invalid depths; cells with any invalid source pixel or a depth step are omitted.
Depth-step gates (0.12 normalized range or 20% axial range per cell) and plane acceptance thresholds are visualization heuristics.
Surface colors are source hero-courtyard:frame:0:run:hero-courtyard-v2 sRGB samples converted to linear RGB; no color is synthesized.
Saved blockout uses at most 1024 vertices; positions and linear colors are rounded to six decimal places.

notes: Generated synthetic demonstration. This does not establish accuracy on anime footage.
Prearranged editable demonstration. It is not the output of an automatic scene reconstruction.
HERO (2018), Blender Foundation, directed by Daniel M. Lara. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HERO_-_Blender_Open_Movie-full_movie.webm. Excerpts near 00:32–00:40 and 01:12–01:20; resized, re-encoded and audio removed. Evidence thumbnails are derived from these excerpts.

HERO visible surfaces were produced locally with pinned Depth Anything V2 Small predictions and inverse-affine visualization priors, plus conservative fitted plane patches. Camera, metric depth, background separation and hidden geometry remain unresolved. These are qualitative development examples, not held-out accuracy measurements.

HERO / still study uses the first frame of the courtyard excerpt as a separate image source. It is repeated evidence, not a new viewpoint. Its depth surface and proposed location link do not provide independent temporal evidence or measured geometric alignment.

limitations: Image regions and their associations are heuristic; they are not semantic objects or identities.

Transition kinds and scores are deterministic heuristics, not probabilities or accuracy claims.
Location proposals require both appearance and distributed geometric features; missing features produce no same-location proposal.
Location proposals do not merge shots and do not estimate an alignment or camera transform.
OpenCV timestamps depend on decoder support; nominal FPS fallback is not exact variable-rate timing.
Unsampled movement and occlusion can be missed; tracks link only adjacent visible evidence samples.
Each mesh is a single-view 2.5D depth hypothesis, not a recovered closed environment.
Cross-frame cameras, static object identities and hidden geometry remain unresolved.
